Select assay ChEMBL ID, target type, tax ID, canonical SMILES, molecule ChEMBL ID, standard type, and pChEMBL value for IC50 activities against human single-protein target CHEMBL1293267. Join molecule_dictionary to activities, assays, and target_dictionary. Join compound_structures to retrieve canonical SMILES. Filter by standard_type = 'IC50', standard_relation = '=', and pchembl_value not null. Order by molecule ChEMBL ID and assay ChEMBL ID. Return the first 1000 rows without deduplication.
